    Put a little love on your home screen

    Your little app, everywhere.

    iPhone / iPad: open this site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Turn on Open as Web App if shown.

    Android: open in Chrome, then use Install app or Add to Home screen in its menu.

    A daily-note widget

    Sign in, then create a code for each device. Widgets can only read today’s note.

    Android widget

    1. Download the Love Notes widget app and install it. Android may ask you to allow this download source.
    2. Open Love Notes Widget and enter a fresh widget code.
    3. Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then Love Notes. Add the daily-note widget.

    iPhone widget · Scriptable

    1. Install Scriptable, the free widget helper.
    2. Download the Love widget script. Or tap Copy iPhone widget script above, create a new script in Scriptable, paste the code, and name it Love Notes.
    3. Run the script once in Scriptable, then enter a fresh widget code when asked.
    4. Add a medium Scriptable widget to your home screen. Edit Widget → Script → Love Notes.

    Your phone controls widget refresh timing. Tap to open the app for the latest note. If a widget loses its connection, make a fresh code and pair it again. Notes aren’t cached by the web app when offline.
